title: AXM primitive
description: A named AXM primitive with a full source trail. Every primitive must map to sources (source_basis), state what it derives (derived_claim), and guard against overclaim (not_source_claim). scripts/validate_primitives.py enforces this schema AND referential integrity against the source ledger.

status.description: settled = rests on a directly-cited external authority; derived = an architectural mapping from sources to an AXM claim; synthesis = AXM-native, resting on repo evidence or analogy only (most guarded).

source_basis.description: At least one source. A primitive with no source_basis is rejected — that is the whole point of the layer.

source_id.description: Must resolve to an entry in the source ledger.

support_type.description: direct_fact = source states the fact; baseline = source sets a requirement the primitive maps onto; repo_evidence = a measured artifact in this repo; external_evidence = supporting external doc; analogy = an explicitly non-literal mapping (requires a not_source_claim disclaiming literalness).

derived_claim.description: The AXM claim derived from the basis. This is synthesis, not a source fact.

not_source_claim.description: Explicit guards: what the sources do NOT say, so synthesis is never laundered into fact.

verifier.description: The command or artifact that checks this primitive.

failure_mode.description: How this primitive degrades if unpoliced.

next_baseline.description: Optional: the next measurement that would sharpen or challenge it.
